FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL REALIZATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCE, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
None appear for the appellant both physically as well as through video conference.

2. On 14.03.2023, this Court had made the following observations:
"None appear.

As a final last opportunity, one week time is granted to comply with office objections,
failing which, the Court may proceed to pass appropriate order including dismissal of the appeal for non-compliance of office objections or non-prosecution.

In case, office objections are not complied with, registry to list this matter on 23.03.2023."
3.
Inspite of the above, appellant has not complied the office objections.
This matter is of the year 2020.
No reasons are forthcoming for non-compliance of office objections.
4. Hence, appeal stands dismissed for non- compliance of office objections and also for non- prosecution.
